decisionForTheFix: The stale reader pin is real and is the first refusal, as the task describes. Two further refusals sit behind it for these buildings
(REGISTRY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and DOCUMENT_STAGE_UNAVAILABLE), because the readers do not use the original-only authority
that the canonical read and the package read already use for geometry-free packages. The fix therefore has two parts:
(1) the split the task asks for: retained document results are located and authorized without current pins on reads and on
snapshot capture, with freshness stated; (2) register, dossier and ledger reads send originals pinned by a geometry-free
package to the existing original-only authority instead of the staged-document one.
